during_workout_templates.formula: Gel + Water + sip of Sports Drink
during_workout_templates.name: Quick Gel Module (T1/T2)
during_workout_templates.notes: Transition-specific. Keep it simple — one gel chased with a quick sip. Do not waste transition time on solids.

during_workout_templates.name: Gel + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: Most portable running option. Chase gel with water to aid absorption. Electrolyte add-on optional.

during_workout_templates.name: (Gel + Water) + Sports Drink
during_workout_templates.notes: Higher carb rate via dual liquid sources. Alternate gel with sports drink sips. Watch total carb concentration to avoid GI issues.

during_workout_templates.name: Chew + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: Easier to pace intake vs. gels. Chewing may reduce nausea for some athletes. Good entry point for newer runners.

during_workout_templates.name: Chew + Water + Sports Drink
during_workout_templates.notes: Dual carb source for longer efforts. Good alternative if gels cause GI distress.

during_workout_templates.name: Sports Drink Only
during_workout_templates.notes: Default for sub-90 min efforts. Sip consistently rather than large boluses. Sufficient for moderate intensity.

during_workout_templates.name: High Carb Drink Mix + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: Highest liquid carb density. Requires well-trained gut. Separate plain water bottle essential to manage osmolality and rinse mouth.

during_workout_templates.name: Bar + Sports Drink + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: Steady energy from solid + liquid combo. Eat in small bites during low-intensity segments. Bars with simple ingredients preferred.

during_workout_templates.name: Bar + (Gel + Water) + Sports Drink
during_workout_templates.notes: Triple source for sustained long rides. Rotate solid -> gel -> drink in cadence. Shift toward gel/liquid as intensity increases.

during_workout_templates.name: Stroopwafel + Sports Drink + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: Highly palatable on-bike option. Warm on top tube to soften. Easy to eat at pace. Popular with triathletes.

during_workout_templates.name: Stroopwafel + (Gel + Water) + Sports Drink
during_workout_templates.notes: Variety prevents flavor fatigue on longer rides. Stroopwafel early, transition to gel as effort intensifies.

during_workout_templates.name: Banana + Sports Drink + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: Real food option with natural potassium. Pre-peel and store in jersey pocket or bento box.

during_workout_templates.name: Banana + (Gel + Water) + Sports Drink
during_workout_templates.notes: Real food + gel combo. Banana early when intensity is lower; transition to gel as effort rises.

during_workout_templates.name: Rice Cake + Sports Drink + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: Savory option breaks sweet monotony. Popular in pro peloton. Wrap in foil for jersey pocket. Real food priority for ultra-long efforts.

during_workout_templates.name: Rice Cake + (Gel + Water) + Sports Drink
during_workout_templates.notes: Best for ultra-long rides. Real food priority with gel bridging for quick carb hits. Shift rice cake -> gel ratio as race progresses.

during_workout_templates.name: Chew + Water (Cycling)
during_workout_templates.notes: Cycling chew option for athletes who prefer chewing over gels. Easier to dose in small bites while riding. Low GI demand.

during_workout_templates.name: Chew + Water + Sports Drink (Cycling)
during_workout_templates.notes: Dual carb source on the bike using chews instead of gels. Good for athletes with gel aversion. Chews easier to portion on long rides.

during_workout_templates.formula: High Carb Drink Mix + Bar + Water
during_workout_templates.name: High Carb Drink Mix + Bar + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: Pro-level fueling: max liquid carb density in the bottle + solid food on top. Requires very well-trained gut. Separate plain water bottle mandatory.

during_workout_templates.formula: High Carb Drink Mix + Stroopwafel + Water
during_workout_templates.name: High Carb Drink Mix + Stroopwafel + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: High carb liquid base + palatable solid. Stroopwafel is easier to eat at tempo than bars. Warm on top tube. Plain water essential to manage osmolality.

during_workout_templates.formula: High Carb Drink Mix + Banana + Water
during_workout_templates.name: High Carb Drink Mix + Banana + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: High carb liquid base + real food. Natural potassium from banana complements the drink mix. Pre-peel banana. Plain water bottle required.

during_workout_templates.formula: High Carb Drink Mix + Rice Cake + Water
during_workout_templates.name: High Carb Drink Mix + Rice Cake + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: Maximum fueling template: high carb liquid + savory solid. Breaks sweet monotony. Pro peloton staple for ultra-long rides and Ironman bike legs. Plain water mandatory.

during_workout_templates.name: Carb Drink Mix + Bar + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: Moderate long-ride bottle option: 60g carb drink mix plus small bites of bar and separate plain water.

during_workout_templates.name: Carb Drink Mix + Stroopwafel + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: Moderate long-ride bottle option with a palatable solid. Plain water remains separate for rinsing and hydration.

during_workout_templates.name: Carb Drink Mix + Banana + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: Moderate long-ride bottle option with real-food carbohydrate. Use early when intensity is lower.

during_workout_templates.formula: Carb Drink Mix + Rice Cake + Water
during_workout_templates.name: Carb Drink Mix + Rice Cake + Water
during_workout_templates.notes: Moderate long-ride bottle option with savory solid food. Plain water is still required alongside the carb bottle.
